# Geoapify

Geoapify offers a suite of APIs for integrating maps, geocoding, routing, and other location-based services into applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/geoapify/.

## Actions

- **Address Autocomplete** (read-only): Fetch address suggestions based on partial input.
- **Batch Requests** (read-only): Create or retrieve batch jobs.
- **Create Marker Icon** (read-only): Create custom map marker icons.
- **Fetch Geoapify Map Tiles** (read-only): Fetch raster map tiles or style JSON from Geoapify.
- **Forward Geocoding** (read-only): Convert an address into geographic coordinates.
- **Generate isoline (isochrone/isodistance)** (read-only): Generate isochrone or isodistance isolines.
- **Geometry Operation** (read-only): Perform geometric operations on stored polygon geometries.
- **Get Administrative Boundaries** (read-only): Retrieve administrative boundaries a location is part of.
- **IP Geolocation** (read-only): Determine geographic location of an IP address.
- **Map Matching** (read-only): Snap GPS traces to the road network and correct inaccuracies.
- **Place Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific place.
- **Places Search** (read-only): Search for points of interest within a specified area.
- **Postcode Search** (read-only): Retrieve postcode information for a location.
- **Reverse Geocoding** (read-only): Reverse geocode coordinates into a structured address.
- **Route Matrix** (read-only): Compute travel time and distance matrices.
- **Route Planner** (read-only): Optimize multi-agent routes and schedules.
- **Routing** (read-only): Calculate routes between multiple waypoints.
